reason: I already get settlement emails and delete them as spam, so a website I have never heard of saying I might qualify for a lawsuit feels like the same trick. You still make me file myself, which I would put off and miss anyway.
objection: How do you even know I qualify? I am not handing my info to a site that admits the listings are unverified.
would_change_my_mind: If my bank or the official claims administrator sent me here, and I could see a settlement that clearly matched a store I shop at without making an account.
